name: Hita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hita city emblem in light blue: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hita, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 14 October 2008; the emblem dates from 5 May 1941.

features.role: Hita city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
